question: In a code language, LETTER is written as MGWXJX. Select the option that will be written as ICNYSG in that language.
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The logic here is:

For the word LETTER is written as MGWZJX as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ebb430e30263db2d72b707ba18d4313aaeea5e5510de602132fa8d48d168e63.png] 

Similarly, which word is written as ICNYSG, we will have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d64ae9d4f2fc4153d7b24c3088b27470f0e3dd9bd3a94a7b0eba097bc012f74b.png] 

Thus, the word '**HUKUNA**' is written as 'ICNYSG'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.
